{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to float, removing commas
# Note: The documentation says revenue is text with thousands separators
# But in the sample, no commas are present. Still, we'll strip them to be safe.
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_mask = (df['revenue'] == 999999.99)
print("QA orders found:", qa_mask.sum())

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_mask = (df['status'] == 'refunded')
print("Refunded orders:", refunded_mask.sum())

# Filter to only converted customers
converted_df = df[df['converted'] == 1]
print("Total converted customers:", len(converted_df))

# Check age: -1 is sentinel for missing, per documentation
missing_age_mask = (converted_df['customer_age'] == -1)
print("Missing age (== -1) in converted group:", missing_age_mask.sum())

# Drop rows with missing age for mean calculation
converted_valid_age = converted_df[~missing_age_mask]['customer_age']
print("Valid age count (non -1) in converted group:", len(converted_valid_age))

# Compute mean age
mean_age = converted_valid_age.mean()
print(f"Mean age of converted customers (excluding -1): {mean_age:.2f}")"}
